apps.name: VoltTune
apps.subtitle: Scooter tuning via Bluetooth
apps.versionDescription: Initial release. Ninebot, Xiaomi, Navee. Sport Mode, Zero Start, Speed Limit, Panic Button.
apps.localizedDescription:
VoltTune connects to your electric scooter via Bluetooth and unlocks its full potential.

• Remove speed limits
• Sport Mode
• Zero Start
• Eco Mode
• Cruise Control
• Panic Button
• Lock & Alarm
• 89 supported models

For use on private property only.

permissions.usageDescription: VoltTune uses Bluetooth to connect to your scooter.
